verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a CLI security scanner, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no telemetry or metrics opt-out control. The --dry-run flag only stops scan results from being uploaded to the web app, and local analysis with no code upload by default is about code privacy. Both are adjacent controls, not usage-tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
